# Foreigner Studio

> Content studio for hospitality, restaurants, lifestyle brands and events: photography, film and content strategy. Creative partner for agencies. Based in Valencia, Spain; working worldwide.

## Key pages
- [Work](https://www.foreignerstudio.com/work): selected hotel, restaurant and lifestyle projects
- [What we do](https://www.foreignerstudio.com/what-we-do): editorial photography, film and monthly social content
- [Who we are](https://www.foreignerstudio.com/about): founder-led studio by Fábio Ribeiro de Almeida Souza
- [Journal](https://www.foreignerstudio.com/journal): documentary stories from Valencia and beyond
- [Start a project](https://www.foreignerstudio.com/contact): hello@foreignerstudio.com
